records.sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_invoice_amount FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS repeat_customers;

SELECT track_id, SUM(quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01') GROUP BY track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice) AS invoice_revenue, (SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity) FROM public.invoice_line) AS detail_revenue, (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice) - (SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity) FROM public.invoice_line) AS difference;
SELECT MIN(invoice_date) AS first_date, MAX(invoice_date) AS last_date FROM public.invoice;
